subject: A free "Your Brain vs AI" session for BITS Hyderabad students
body:
Dear Dean, Student Welfare Division,

I read that BITS Pilani has made the Social Conduct course, with its focus on emotional intelligence and well-being, compulsory for first-years across campuses. It is a thoughtful step.

I run UnAI Labs, where I teach short, science-backed courses on AI literacy, neuroplasticity, deep focus and brain health, in plain language. I would like to offer BITS Hyderabad a free 45-minute session, "Your Brain vs AI", for any group of students, online or on campus. It is based on published research and leaves students with three habits they can use the same week.

Would a date in November or December suit you?

Warm regards,
Manish Kumar Singh
Founder, UnAI Labs
unai-labs.com

If you would rather not hear from me again, reply "no thanks" and I will not write again.
